description: Asked to hear it without the margin, and kept the boy unchanged.
name: Augustine Phillips

description: Refused to weep before the cause, and gave the scene plain.
name: Nick Sorrell

description: Forgot to fidget, and kept his cue where it was.
name: Richard Burbage

description: Spoke in the passage after Gaunt's death, and did not go to the Rose.
name: William Shakespeare
